article.title: A Different Way to School
article.content:
For a month, Noah’s usual bus stop was closed because workers were repairing the road. The next bus stop was twenty minutes from his home. At first, he worried about being late. His neighbour Mia suggested cycling together. They tried the route on Sunday, when they had plenty of time. The journey took fifteen minutes, and most of it followed a quiet path beside the river.

On Monday, they left a little earlier and reached school before the bell. Noah enjoyed the fresh air, but cycling was not possible every day. When heavy rain arrived on Thursday, Mia’s father drove them. Noah learned that having a second plan made the change easier.
article.translation:
道路维修使诺亚常去的公交站关闭了一个月。下一个站离家有二十分钟路程。起初，他担心迟到。邻居米娅建议一起骑车。他们周日时间充裕，先试走了路线。骑车只需十五分钟，大部分路程沿着河边安静的小路。

周一，他们稍早出发，在上课铃响前到校。诺亚喜欢新鲜空气，但并不是每天都能骑车。周四下大雨时，米娅的爸爸开车送他们。诺亚发现，准备第二种方案能让变化更容易应对。

questions.prompt: Why did Noah need a different route?
options: His usual bus stop was closed
questions.explanation: 第一句说明原来的公交站因修路而关闭。

questions.prompt: Why did they try the route on Sunday?
options: They had enough time to check it
The river path was only open on Sunday
Mia’s father asked them to race
questions.explanation: “when they had plenty of time”说明他们有充足时间预先熟悉路线。

questions.prompt: What is the main lesson of the story?
options: Cycling is always faster than a car
A backup plan can help with change
questions.explanation: 最后一段说大雨时改为坐车，末句总结第二种方案使变化更容易应对。
